directive: Find an urgent, recurring workflow bottleneck for solo freelancers solvable with a $0-stack Python/local automation priced $9-$29 one-time.

candidates.title: InvoicePulse — Zero-Subscription Overdue Invoice Follow-Up Automation
candidates.buyer_persona: Solo freelance developers, designers, and boutique consultants
candidates.recurring_pain: Losing hours weekly writing awkward unpaid-invoice follow-up emails and watching AP quietly overlook invoices, while resenting $25-$59/mo CRM suites and 4%-6.9% SaaS fee markups.
candidates.current_workaround: Manual Gmail reminders + spreadsheets or overpaying for bloated CRM subscriptions
candidates.urgency_signal: Direct cashflow delay and recurring monthly subscription fatigue

evidence.verbatim_quote: I kept losing hours every week writing 'just checking in' emails for unpaid invoices — and I knew every other freelancer was doing the same.

The invoicing SaaS I was using to bill my clients raised its credit card processing fee to 6.9% for free accounts (4% on top of Stripe's 2.9% + 30c fee), so I decided to build my own to fit my minimal needs.
I thought I had a good relationship with one client and that invoices were being paid on time, but then I found that around £10k had been overlooked by AP over the course of a few years.
The idea came from repeatedly watching freelancers (and honestly, myself) lose time to admin just to get paid.

competitors.name: HoneyBook
competitors.main_gap: High monthly recurring fee and heavy CRM bloat for solo freelancers who only need clean payment follow-ups.

competitors.name: Dubsado
competitors.main_gap: Requires $55/mo Premier tier for automated workflows and steep initial configuration.

competitors.name: HelloBonsai
competitors.main_gap: Per-seat recurring billing and basic tier omits full invoicing workflows.

competitors.name: Moxie
competitors.main_gap: Still requires ongoing SaaS subscription and cloud lock-in for client billing data.

market_roi_analyst_rounds.top_distribution_risk: Zero-budget organic customer acquisition depends on shipping an open-core Show HN / r/SideProject launch with live founder engagement.
